normalization.repair_note: documented source-variant repairs: the live Sejm API itself returns the l-variant ('calość'; verified 2026-10-28, term4/106/11); repairs applied AFTER casefold (keys lowercase) so case variants are caught; each entry explicit and curated - no general diacritic stripping

notes: rules are ordered; first match wins
needle normalization preserves leading/trailing whitespace (leading space = word-boundary anchor: ' i czytaniu' must not match 'w ii czytaniu')
election: contains 'wybór' (accented) + contains 'wybor' (unaccented inflections, excluding 'wyborcz' = electoral-law bills) + contains 'nad wyborem'
the l-variant 'calość' is a source-side API artifact (the live API returns it; verified 2026-10-28, term4/106/11), not a pipeline bug
empty, missing, or '-' descriptions are outside the layer-1 universe (inventory docs/inventory-description.json)
buckets with volume below the minimum count defined in the release PR are reported but not used in aggregates (CODEBOOK section 8)
frozen endgame: at freeze the dictionary becomes the exhaustive normalized-formula->bucket table (docs/layer1-formula-buckets.json, CI-diffed); rules remain the proposer for new formulas
